# Events stream into the staging table

The ingest service writes each event to the queue, and a consumer fills the staging table.

## Goal

Goal. Every web event lands in the staging table within 10 minutes of capture.
Decision. Can M1 demo a click in staging?
Done when. `bun scripts/event-lag.ts --table staging` prints under 10 minutes, and today it fails.

## Scope

- In. Web events.
- Out. Mobile events, which B03 covers.

## Decisions

| # | Kind | Decision | Rejected | Door | Settled | Record |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | tech | The consumer writes in batches of 500 events | One insert per event, 40 times slower in the bench | two-way | evidence | branch:prototype/batch-size |
